how: docs/steps/step-4a/probes: image t3flare-probe4a (node 24 bookworm, codex 0.167.2 aarch64 musl, pi 1.5.2 from npm); keyhost sidecar = computer.internal (key route, key only in its env) + CONNECT logger; protocol logs in docs/steps/step-4a/out/ (not committed)

P3.bearer: Commissary accepts the cms_ key as `Authorization: Bearer` on /v1/models and /v1/responses
P3.decision: Codex lists the whole catalog (every family drives tools through Commissary's Responses API)
required: CODEX_HOME must not be under /tmp: Codex refuses to make its helper aliases (apply_patch) there
-c allow_login_shell=false: Debian/Ubuntu /etc/profile resets PATH in `bash -lc`, so the apply_patch alias is 'command not found' and models fall back to shell writes

P4.keyHelperRunsPerTurn: one per model request (3 in a two-tool turn)
P4.models: a custom `models` list on the built-in anthropic provider is merged with pi's built-ins (20 available)
P4.sessionDir: PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR wins over a hostile repo's .pi/settings.json sessionDir (the repo's directory was never created); sessions are flat files in that dir

P8_local.codex: turn 1, then a fresh CODEX_HOME and CODEX_SQLITE_HOME (only sessions/ linked to the synced dir) and the rollout's last line cut in half: thread/resume of the same id completed and recalled the word
P8_local.pi: turn 1, then a fresh agent dir and the session file's last line cut in half: switch_session succeeded and recalled the word
P8_local.conclusion: CODEX_SQLITE_HOME on Container-local disk is the default (F2); only sessions/ is synced

P10.network: an --internal Docker network: the CLI's only way out is the CONNECT logger
P10.codexSettings: features.plugins, plugin_discovery_prefetch, remote_plugin, plugin_sharing = false (these alone remove github.com and chatgpt.com); apps, tool_suggest, analytics off as well; check_for_update_on_startup=false

P11_codex.nonce: F4 confirmed: with Codex's default shell policy a shell sees T3FLARE_MODEL_KEY_NONCE (count 1); with -c shell_environment_policy.exclude=["T3FLARE_MODEL_KEY_NONCE"] it does not (0) and the shell's helper call reaches the route with no nonce
P11_codex.repoConfig: a repo's .codex/config.toml with model_provider/model_providers is ignored: 'Ignored unsupported project-local config keys … model_provider, model_providers'
P11_codex.processLevelApproval: F5 amended: Codex 0.167.2 refuses `-c approval_policy="untrusted"` at process level ('no longer supported; remove this setting'); the per-turn approvalPolicy "untrusted" still works. The process default is approval_policy="on-request" with sandbox_mode="read-only"; every turn/start carries the guard's own policy

P2_local.bwrap: fails in Docker Desktop (no unprivileged user namespaces); the stage probe decides for Cloudflare

matrix_without_sandbox.untrusted+readOnly: asked: fileChange, command (both ran after approval)
matrix_without_sandbox.on-request+workspaceWrite: asked: fileChange, then the command failed in the broken sandbox and asked to escalate
matrix_without_sandbox.untrusted+dangerFullAccess: asked: the command (the model wrote with the shell)

P2_local.conclusion: without a sandbox, untrusted asks before every write and every command: the fail-closed column of §5.1 holds

P11_pi_mode: answered by code (F9): pi's adapter reports supportsRuntimeModeSwitchInSession=false and Orchestrator.ts:4626-4632 detaches such sessions on thread.runtime-mode.set, so the next turn spawns pi with the new mode
